name: Spark Protocol
storyline:
In a world drowned in relentless rain and endless darkness, a group of scientists discovers a tiny being… but their intentions are far from noble.

S.P.A.R.K. - that’s the codename.

Dive into this electrifying adventure across seven levels + one secret extra stage to uncover the truth behind our mysterious protagonist. Dash through danger, dodge obstacles, evade security cameras, laser turrets, and countless deadly traps using your electric dash.

Nothing can stop you now. Push forward, survive the storm, and uncover the truth waiting at the end of the path.
